fact: A USAID Good Governance Activity workshop on 23-24 July 2024 was to standardise and assess tools for tracking revenue, registering taxpayers and budgeting for decentralised territorial entities; the activity works with 20 entities in four provinces (Haut Katanga, Lualaba, Tshopo, Haut Uele), and the entity tier is not stated.
